name: bringup-d2-scan
about: Bring-up matrix row scan (D2) TRUE-PASS ladder: ready -> ctx_create t1 (g0 id1 key 0x64) -> txq_sync72 -> iw iface add wlan0 (provider user_add g0 id7/id8) -> link up -> ONE iw dev wlan0 scan (provider vap_add g0 id1 48 B + vap_start g0 id1 40 B + scan_req g0 id0xC 520 B). PASS gates: iw rc=0, dmesg 'cfg80211: scan channel result' present, scan results>0, mask/staging 0, golden boot page/state. BLOCKED-DRIVER (not FAIL) only when the ladder ran but the firmware produced nothing: scan accepted rc=0 with results=0 + the driver's own 'scan DONE (finish-abort, results=0 ...)' dmesg line. Requires the wifi-vap-start provider module (vap_start_mode=1, allow_frames=12); see PHASES.md sec 5 decision table.

steps.name: note-ladder
steps.about: D2 ladder: this row is only meaningful on the wifi-vap-start provider module (../wifi-vap-start/provider/vapstart-provider.patch, built with ../wifi-vap-start/tools/kernel-check.sh, 738,112 B sha256 e09dc697...): vap_start_first=1 requires the core ACTIVE after ctx_create+txq, and vap_start_mode=1 is the hardware-validated VAP create path that makes the firmware scan handler produce results. The plain cfg80211/scan-ap module is refused at plan time (module-param-unknown = BLOCKED-PREREQ), never silently mis-run.

steps.name: cfg-status
steps.about: wiphy registered after the ready handshake (the cfg80211 preamble already waits for /sys/class/ieee80211; this is the sequence-local re-gate)

steps.name: pre-pack
steps.about: pre-create state on this fresh boot: no context (ctx4+0x190 = 0), exception mask 0, exception staging word 0

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: prerequisite 1/2: ONE context-create H2D (g0 id1 key 0x64, data[0]=type 1) - the 2026-11-26 mode-1 bench ladder had this consumed in 0 polls before the scan

steps.name: post-create
steps.about: the create allocated the measured ctx4 body (same PACK as C2: ctx4[0]=4, ctx4+0x10=0x00010001, ctx4+0x434=0x0100478C)

steps.name: txq-sync72
steps.about: prerequisite 2/2: ONE TXQ config sync H2D (g0 id1 cmd 0xd8, 72-byte node) -> the core is ACTIVE before the provider VAP/scan sequence (vap_start_first=1)

steps.name: post-txq
steps.about: the TXQ handler ran clean: exception mask and staging word stay 0

steps.name: vap-add
steps.about: iw phy phy0 interface add wlan0 type managed -> add_virtual_intf -> provider user_add g0 id7 180 B + user_add_notify g0 id8 180 B (hardware: 1/12 + 2/12 consumed). A user_add post failure keeps the netdev live and is caught by the frame_post gate below

steps.name: link-up
steps.about: bring the managed netdev up; nl80211 refuses scan requests on a down interface

steps.name: vap-added
steps.about: the driver VAP model recorded wlan0 (real netdev); the provider user frames are gated by the post-scan frame_post counters

steps.name: catalog-baseline
steps.about: D2H catalogue before the scan request (evidence baseline: no scan-event family present yet)

steps.name: scan
blocked_patterns: scan needs an H2D frame provider
steps.about: ONE nl80211 scan request: the provider posts vap_add g0 id1 48 B + vap_start g0 id1 40 B + scan_req g0 id0xC 520 B (hardware: 3/12, 4/12, 5/12) and the firmware answers with g1 id17 channel results + g1 id15 beacons. iw rc=0 also holds for an ABORTED scan (iw prints 'scan aborted!' and returns 0): results>0 is gated by the scan-results attr below, results=0 is the documented BLOCKED outcome. Legacy fail-closed stub still records BLOCKED via blocked_rc

steps.name: scan-settle
steps.about: bounded wait for the firmware scan events to reach the direct reader and the driver's scan-done log

steps.name: scan-results
steps.about: PASS gate results>0: the driver scan model counted the parsed results (hardware 2026-11-26 14:00: results=6 bss=6 channel=6 after 6 channels, finish-abort at the provider 5 s bound). BLOCKED-DRIVER branch: scan accepted but results=0 - the firmware produced nothing (VAP/scan-state wall or decode gap), so the row is BLOCKED, not FAIL

steps.name: scan-dmesg
steps.about: PASS gate: the cfg80211 scan event handler logged at least one 'cfg80211: scan channel result slot=.. ch=.. (.. MHz)' line (g1 id17 decode). BLOCKED-DRIVER branch: the driver's own 'scan DONE (finish-abort, results=0 ...)' line is present - the ladder ran, the firmware returned no results

steps.name: post-scan-pack
steps.about: hard gate: the provider scan sequence did not fault the firmware (mask 0, staging 0); a nonzero value here is FAIL, never BLOCKED

steps.name: post-scan-page
steps.about: hard gate: the golden boot handshake page and boot state survived the scan ladder

steps.name: frame-post
steps.about: the provider wire path accepted every ladder frame (hardware 5/12 posted: user_add, user_add_notify, vap_add, vap_start, scan_req) with no refusal/timeout/bad frame. The exact posted count is captured in the evidence but not gated (the PASS gates are the scan result gates)

steps.name: h2d-summary
steps.about: the two prerequisite H2D frames (ctx_create + txq_sync72) were consumed and none was refused

steps.name: catalog-after
steps.about: watch/evidence: capture the D2H catalogue after the scan. Hardware 14:00 saw g1 id17 count=6 (124 B channel results) + g1 id15 count=6 (509 B beacon frames); the catalogue is captured, not gated (the scan-results + dmesg gates are the PASS decision)

steps.name: vap-del
steps.about: tear the VAP down again (provider user_del g0 id9); a failure after a green scan is a teardown defect, not a scan verdict change

steps.name: note-end
steps.about: D2 PASS = scan ladder completed + iw scan rc=0 + dmesg 'scan channel result' + results>0 + mask/staging 0 + golden page/state + no provider refusal. BLOCKED-DRIVER = scan rc=0 but results=0 (documented pending-feature outcome, the two blocked gates above). Any other nonzero gate (provider rc, firmware exception, page drift) is FAIL/STOP. Decision table: PHASES.md sec 5; never retry a scan on the same boot
